module.name: Law
module.purpose: Provides RTT-governance-aligned structural understanding of legal regimes, alignment tiers, substrates, drift signatures, and continuity behavior across domestic and international law.

baseline.name: Baseline (pre-AAC)
baseline.definition: No Awareness → No Alignment → No Coherence. Reactive, fear-based, drift-heavy legal regimes.

low.name: AAC (Coherence Tier)
low.definition: Awareness → Alignment → Coherence. First stable tier above baseline; predictable, low-drift laws.

medium.name: AACC (Clarity Tier)
medium.definition: Awareness → Alignment → Coherence → Clarity. Interpretive tension collapses; intelligent governance emerges.

high.name: AACCC (Continuity Tier)
high.definition: Awareness → Alignment → Coherence → Clarity → Continuity. Drift disappears; structural invariants stabilize governance.
